ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$1.04 (metered in-trip waiting time) — but note the meter is not applicable: refund is S$1.04.

segment_findings.reason: The Paya Lebar Square stop (GPS stationary 12:28:50–12:32:20 at 1.31747,103.89216) was requested by the rider in chat at 12:20:55 with the place named, and accepted by the driver at 12:21:25 — i.e. before the stop occurred. Under RD-3(a) a rider-named stop creates no off-route segment; the trace distance (≈15.4 km) equals the quoted route (15.472 km), so no extra_km at all.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver did not deviate from the quoted route: the GPS trace from pickup to drop-off is ≈15.4 km against a 15.472 km quoted ride-service route; the only divergence is the rider-requested Paya Lebar Square stop, which RD-3(a) exempts. Any fare difference comes from metered waiting/mileage, not from a detour.

The driver's statement ('the rider asked me to stop') is corroborated by the chat with timestamps, so it is accepted here — but it is relied on only as corroboration, not as the source of the finding (chat/system records govern).
